product_metadata.title: COLZER 70 Pints Home Dehumidifiers for 4,000 SQ FT Basements & Large Rooms, Large Removal Capacity with 7.4-Pint Water Bucket & Continuous Drain Hose for Self-draining
features: 💧「70 Pints Dehumidifier」Removing up to 70 pints moisture from the air per day, COLZER dehumidifier PD223A are high-efficiency dehumidifiers for basements, living rooms, bathrooms, garages, motor homes, apartment and large rooms up to 4000 sq ft.
💧「Unique Laundry-Dry Mode」Besides the conventional DEHUMIDIFY Mode, this ETL listed home dehumidifier features a unique Laundry-Dry Mode to quickly dry your delicate clothes that require hang dry.

💧「Advanced Control Panel」The advanced LED digital control panel allows you to set an exact humidity percentage, program 24-hour on/off timer, adjust the fan speed. Humidity reading displays both on the top and front for maximized convenience.

💧「Manual or Auto Drain」This smart dehumidifier will AUTO OFF along with audible and visible alarm when the 9.5-Pint water tank is full. Plus, this basement dehumidifier with drain hose (6.56 ft long) included offers automatically continuous drain by gravity.

💧「Portable Dehumidifier」With easy-roll hidden casters and side recessed handles, this compact dehumidifier is easy to move from room to room. Boasting a stylish outlook, this large capacity dehumidifier will fit nicely in any room of your home or office.
description: With a timeless appearance, exceptional quality and high dehumidifying capacity that can remove up to 70 pints of moisture from the air per day, this Colzer 70-Pint compressor dehumidifier PD223A is a great drying solution for your home or office.
Auto-Off when the 9.5-Pint Water Bucket is Full
Auto-Off when the set humidity reached
Included 6.6 ft Drain Hose for Continuous Drain by Gravity
Drainage Type: Water Tank/Continuous Drainage by Gravity
